04 /OBJECT NO. 9 // RESTRICTED INTELLIGENCE

An experimental girl associated with the same project as Rosmontis was extracted in a capsule for Columbia. Katar PMC was implicated. The transport helicopter disappeared from communications, and later intelligence indicated a possible transfer to Shaltorgrad. Aires released Valery Ishchukov from detention for insufficient evidence of espionage while retaining increased supervision and reporting requirements.

03 /OPERATOR BRIEF

Aires «Banshee», formerly «Static», is a 22 year old Vouivre and Senior Lieutenant of Blacksteel Worldwide. She commands SPECTRE and personally leads NIGHTFALL, its independent special operations squad. An agile close range fighter specializing in submachine guns, she combines decisive field leadership with accountability, fairness and a protective attitude toward her operatives.

04 / SERVICE BIOGRAPHY

01 / PROFILE

PERSONAL BACKGROUND

Aires is a 22 year old Vouivre serving as a Senior Lieutenant of Blacksteel Worldwide. She is known for her black hair with pink streaks, distinctive horns, energetic temperament and disciplined approach to command. Her birthplace and early education are not recorded.

02 / FAMILY

FAMILY

Aires had a younger brother named Elias, who died during a conflict when she was approximately fifteen. The circumstances remain private.

03 / SERVICE

BLACKSTEEL CAREER

A close range combat specialist, Aires favors submachine guns and lightweight tactical equipment. She later assumed command of SPECTRE and personally leads the independent NIGHTFALL squad under the callsign Banshee, previously Static.

04 / PERSONAL

PERSONAL LIFE

Outside duty, Aires is known for her teasing humor and loyalty to people close to her. She maintains a close relationship with Rhodes Island medic and researcher Himvarm «Fai». Further personal details are not included in the general personnel file.

04 /SERVICE & COMMAND

Aires has led Blacksteel personnel in field operations, organized patrols and briefings, coordinated joint movements with Rhodes Island, and appointed corporals within her unit. She currently holds the rank of Senior Lieutenant and commands SPECTRE, including direct command of NIGHTFALL. Her initial personnel profile listed Lieutenant.

05 /PERSONAL PROFILE

Confident and energetic, Aires uses dry humor and teasing with people she trusts. In command she is disciplined, fair, and protective of her team. Her younger brother Elias died during a conflict when she was approximately fifteen, a defining loss in her history.

OPEN SEALED MEDICAL ASSESSMENT

PND is a rare, progressive disorder affecting neural tissue and its vascular supply. Initial presentation may include episodic headaches, hand tremors, exhaustion, dizziness and transient coordination loss. Advanced progression may involve blackouts, severe motor impairment and systemic complications. The disease is distinct from Oripathy and is not attributed to Originium exposure. No definitive cure is recorded. Supportive care may manage symptoms but is not expected to halt progression. No exact life expectancy or stage has been established in the available record. Operational fitness requires periodic reassessment. This diagnosis is a proposed classified storyline entry; onset, cause, treating physician and disclosure to other personnel have not yet been established.

02 / FAMILY INCIDENT

DEATH OF ELIAS

When Aires was approximately fifteen, Elias died during a conflict. The location, responsible parties and precise sequence of events have not been established. His death is a confirmed personal loss, not a verified explanation for every later decision. Command observers note that Aires places considerable importance on the survival and welfare of personnel under her authority. 03 / SERVICE DEVELOPMENT

RECRUITMENT AND ADVANCEMENT

Aires entered Blacksteel Worldwide and developed as a mobile close range fighter, preferring submachine guns, including the MP5. She possesses no established Originium Arts and no known augmentations. The exact enlistment date, initial assignment, training results and promotion dates have not been recovered. Her present rank is Senior Lieutenant.

04 / COMMAND RECORD

LEADERSHIP UNDER PRESSURE

As an officer, Aires coordinated deployments, rescue efforts and joint activity with Rhodes Island. Operations associated with her command include triangulation towers, a fuel complex, screening system expeditions and the continuing Object №9 investigation. Her observed approach balances mission readiness with discretion: she supports initiative, but expects notification of sensitive movements and reporting of significant discoveries.

05 / COMMAND RESPONSIBILITY

SPECTRE AND NIGHTFALL

Aires commands SPECTRE, comprising SPEARHEAD, LIFELINE, FORGE and NIGHTFALL. She personally commands NIGHTFALL, a standalone squad outside SPEARHEAD authority. NIGHTFALL handles sensitive assignments under strict operational discretion. Aires expects loyalty and obedience to lawful command decisions, while accepting responsibility for orders issued in her name. The precise date and circumstances of NIGHTFALL’s formation have not been established.

06 / PRIVATE ASSOCIATION

HIMVARM «FAI»

Himvarm «Fai», a Rhodes Island medic and researcher, is not simply a professional contact or someone who helped Aires recover. He is the man she loves, and their feelings are openly mutual. Their bond grew during her recovery, through long nights, difficult conversations, shared vulnerability and the comfort they found in each other. Away from command duties, Aires lets herself be affectionate: she holds him close, teases him gently, kisses him and finds peace in the sound of his purring. Fai, in turn, seeks her warmth and company, openly expressing how precious she has become to him. They have imagined a quieter life together, even a beach in Bolívar where they could finally rest without the weight of constant operations. A lasting future has been hinted at, but no formal engagement has been recorded.

07 / MEDICAL HISTORY

CRITICAL INJURY AND RECOVERY

Aires sustained serious operational injuries requiring oxygen support, monitoring and blood or plasma transfusions. She subsequently regained consciousness and continued recovery under medical supervision. The incident contributed to her personal connection with Fai. The exact injury date, full diagnosis and long term prognosis are not available in this attachment.

08 / COMMAND ASSESSMENT

JUDGMENT AND VULNERABILITIES

Aires demonstrates strong personal loyalty and a protective approach to her subordinates. In the Valery Ishchukov investigation, she rejected continued detention on unsubstantiated espionage allegations while retaining supervision and reporting requirements. This illustrates a preference for proportional discipline and evidence based decisions. Her family loss and personal relationships may influence her priorities, but no formal psychological diagnosis or fitness restriction is established.
